hypothesis: W-R9's sorted-row plus first-anchor grouping may be insensitive to permutations of temporal order that preserve those statistics; this would invalidate interpreting W-R9 alone as a temporal-order mechanism.
freeze: Preregistration committed before the first experiment workflow is installed/triggered. No parameter selection after any heldout observations. No experimental rerun without new explicit preregistration.
population: Nine independent entities, three families per entity, 16 ordered four-channel observations from the exact W-R9 deterministic formula; 8 seeds total.
arms: control: identical ordered rows for all three families
intervention: family0 unchanged, family1 reverses observations 1..15, family2 rotates observations 1..15 left by five; preserve anchor row0 and the complete multiset
metrics: independent full chronological-sequence exact grouping cardinality
per-family anchor equality, multiset equality, and nonidentical time sequences
primary_falsification: For every heldout seed, control sorted-anchor score=9 and scrambled sorted-anchor score=9 while scrambled chronological score=0; if observed, classify TEMPORAL_ORDER_BLIND rather than claiming temporal-order competence.
alternative: FALSIFICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED on any heldout disagreement; INVALID if preservation, split, or source identity invariants fail.
validation: Deterministic repeated output, independent chronological comparator, exact W-R9 source Git blob identity, full repository regression once. Preserve all scientific outcomes.
claim_limit: Synthetic causal identifiability of this scorer only; no real-language learning, downstream promotion, or accepted-ref modification.
